description: This file defines API endpoints related to the Anthropic messaging interface within a FastAPI application. It includes routes for processing message requests (`/v1/messages`) and token counting (`/v1/messages/count_tokens`), interfacing with internal request processing and external authentication modules.

classes.name: ProxyBaseLLMRequestProcessing
classes.description: Handles the processing of LLM requests, including core request handling and SSE data streaming.

classes.name: TokenCountRequest
classes.description: Represents a request structure for token counting operations, comprising model name and messages.

classes.name: TokenCountResponse
classes.description: Response structure for token counting, including total token count.

classes.name: ProxyException
classes.description: Custom exception class used to represent errors during proxy request processing.

methods.name: anthropic_response( fastapi_response: Response, request: Request, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to `/v1/messages`, processing messages in the Anthropic format, including error handling and optional streaming responses.

methods.name: count_tokens( request: Request, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to `/v1/messages/count_tokens`, performing token counting for incoming messages, and returning token count information.

ctags.name: anthropic_response
ctags.signature: ( fastapi_response: Response, request: Request, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )

ctags.name: internal_token_counter
ctags.pattern: /^    from litellm.proxy.proxy_server import token_counter as internal_token_counter$/
